name: live-data-rewrite
summary: Plan, review, sample, apply, verify, and reconcile a bulk write to live records keyed to exact revisions or derived state, with paced external calls.
side_effects: authorized bulk writes to live records
paid or throttled external calls within a stated budget
private plan, ledger, and log files outside Git
triggers: apply a bulk data cleanup plan
exclusions: schema migrations owned by a release procedure
research about data or embedding providers
